engineering_observations: All thirty bad output sample brackets have cmos/level16/level8 path inputs above100mV. Later selected interfaces show progressive degradation: level4 weak at2 events, final input weak at17 (wrong at6), output weak at30 (wrong at14). Counts apply only to these bad-event native brackets, not a replacement full-interface acceptance gate.

The worst VCE device is physically bound final f bank a/sp selector Nx6. At its minimum, VBE0.88258V and native Ic5.941mA coexist with only98.50uV public-to-base difference. This supports a headroom observation; it does not establish deficient clock drive.
The minimum-VCE witness belongs to bit128, absent from the22 bad sampled bits; the safety and output-sample failures are not causally equated.
Seventy-three failures map to selectors and two to final tail devices; XD5644 is unclassified by the589-device tree catalogue and remains explicitly unclassified.
Thermal states were never saved by the original contract; no thermal cause or temperature values are inferred.
method: Project already published native-row records only. Each event retains both adjacent native frames; stage minima/maxima span all physical parallel combinations, never interpolate new diagnostic values. Original interpolated acceptance samples and original rejection remain separate. No circuit or oracle changes.
